dedupe_keys.name: consumer affairs agency recall information site japan recalls exchanges and refunds of food and consumer products searchable by category

description: This site is the Japanese government's central list of product recalls, including recalls, exchanges and refunds of food and drink. It is run by the Consumer Affairs Agency (CAA). Each notice gives the date it was registered, the product category, the company and product, and the action taken, such as exchange or refund, recall, or a recall order issued by the authorities. Categories cover food, home appliances, household goods, clothing, health and hygiene goods, vehicles, buildings and equipment. New food entries appear most days; on the day the site was read the newest food notices were dated 25 September 2026. The site is free and available to browse and search without registration, but no bulk download, feed or API was found on the pages read, and the footer states that all rights are reserved. Caveats: records have to be read notice by notice, the reason for each recall has to be read from each notice, and distribution volumes are not given. Simulation uses: building event histories of food safety incidents to set disruption frequencies for food supply models, and testing how recalls of widely distributed products propagate to retailers. Related records: the French RappelConso recalls (data-rappelconso-product-recalls), the UK FSA food alerts API (data-fsa-food-alerts-api) and the German food warnings (data-lebensmittelwarnung-food-warnings-germany) are comparable national sources.
